verdict.rationale: Auth0 explicitly documents machine-to-machine Client Credentials flow for non-human/service identities, RBAC for scoping permissions, and a dedicated 'Auth0 for AI Agents' offering that gives 'each agent a unique digital identity for more secure access to APIs, apps, and MCP servers,' plus Token Vault to scope/manage agent access to third-party tools without sharing user credentials. This directly matches the least-privilege, per-agent identity story with defined scopes and revocable tokens. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of instant/programmatic revocation semantics for agent tokens and independent/hands-on validation of this specific AI-agent identity flow (evidence is first-party docs only).
